infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Mowa uses motion and fitness data to detect when you have been walking, so it can offer to save the walk as a diary entry.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Mowa uses your location to record where your walk took place.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Mowa needs Always location access so it can keep detecting walks while the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Mowa reads your step count and walking distance from Health to describe your walk.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Mowa does not write health data, but HealthKit requires this key in order to request read permission.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Mowa uses your location to record where your walk took place.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Mowa needs Always location access so it can keep detecting walks while the app is in the background.

plugins.photosPermission: Mowa lets you attach a photo from your library to a walk diary entry.
plugins.cameraPermission: Mowa lets you take a photo to attach to a walk diary entry.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Mowa reads your step count and walking distance from Health to describe your walk.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Mowa does not write health data, but HealthKit requires this key in order to request read permission.
